description: mise tools: enable the manager and group every tool update in mise.toml into a single PR, since all tools share one mise.toml and mise.lock and separate PRs would conflict.

packageRules.description: Group all mise tool updates into one PR (they all edit the same mise.toml and mise.lock)

A Python minor in mise.toml (3.14 -> 3.15) is a new interpreter, the same hazard docker.json holds back for the base image: CI's tests would move to it while the runtime image stays put, so a pass would say nothing about what ships. Raise it alone and never auto-merge it; move it together with the python-app images.
